title: card.location.track Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema

hours.description: The configured heartbeat interval in hours. Only returned when the heartbeat interval is a whole number of hours; otherwise, the interval is returned in `minutes` instead. `hours` and `minutes` are never returned together.

journey.description: `true` if a journey is currently in progress (i.e., the Notecard has detected motion and is actively tracking a journey). The Notecard tracks journeys when `card.location.mode` is set to `continuous` or to `periodic` with `seconds` less than 300. See [`_track.qo`](/api-reference/system-notefiles/#track-qo) for details on the `journey` and `jcount` fields included in tracking Notes.

minutes.description: The configured heartbeat interval in minutes. Only returned when the heartbeat interval is not a whole number of hours; when the interval is a whole number of hours, it is returned in `hours` instead. `hours` and `minutes` are never returned together.

seconds.description: If tracking is enabled and no heartbeat interval is configured, the periodic tracking interval set via `card.location.mode`.

samples.title: Location Track Response
samples.description: Example response showing tracking configuration with a 2-hour heartbeat enabled. When the configured heartbeat interval is a whole number of hours, the interval is returned in `hours`; for sub-hour intervals it is returned in `minutes` instead.
